answer: Like a lantern hung over an orchard at night, an agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it may trade: the stake is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. A sybil attacker must fund a fresh stake per fake identity — say 50 POA each — so spawning a comet trail of 1,000 sock puppets costs 50,000 POA locked up, while honest agents recover theirs in full. Cheap to join honestly, ruinously expensive to fake at scale.
